orientation: W[post, pre]; absolute weights are synapse counts, sign is the modeled presynaptic transmitter sign.
scope: Direct postsynaptic cell annotations from the reconstructed connectome. Soma neuromere describes the target cell, not the location of a synapse.
limitations: No synapse-level neuropil/ROI coordinates are present in the model inputs. These tables do not assign axon terminal regions or establish a flight-specific function for each descending neuron.
